Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.replication

Class ReplicationPaths

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.replication.ReplicationPaths
  • public class ReplicationPaths
extends Object
    Contains information necessary to translate paths during replication: the release root and the source and target path.

      • trimToOrigin

        @Nullable
public @Nullable String trimToOrigin​(@Nullable
                                     @Nullable String path)
        Returns the intersection of path and getOrigin(). If path is contained in getOrigin(), it is returned unchanged. If it contains getOrigin(), getOrigin() is returned. Otherwise we return null.

      • getReleaseRoot

        @NotNull
public @NotNull String getReleaseRoot()
        The release root - normally the site that is replicated.

      • getSourcePath

        @Nullable
public @Nullable String getSourcePath()
        Optionally a path within the getReleaseRoot() that is replicated. If this is not set, the whole release is replicated.

      • getTargetPath

        @Nullable
public @Nullable String getTargetPath()
        Optionally, a path where the getSourcePath() (or the whole getReleaseRoot() if that isn't set) is replicated. If not set, each path is replicated as is.

      • getContentPath

        @Nullable
public @Nullable String getContentPath()
        A path within the getSourcePath() / getReleaseRoot() that is replicated / compared / whatever. The meaning of this path depends on the context. If was outside getOrigin(), it is trimmed to the origin
